heroHeadline: Libya's Rivals Ink Election Roadmap in Tunis as Security Cracks Widen
heroSubtitle: An eight-member UN-brokered committee initialled a deal on electoral-law reform and elections-commission restructuring on August 20 — even as UNSMIL disputed the leaked text, an ammunition depot exploded near Misrata, and the unclaimed assassination of LNA intelligence chief Fawzi al-Mansouri and repeated drone strikes on the Zawiya refinery still overshadow the fragile GNU-GNS thaw.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
